department: PhD Program in Biomedical Sciences (Jacobs School of Medicine and Biomedical Sciences)

deadline.value: Application and all documents are due December 1; no extensions.
deadline.quote: Your application must be completed, and ALL supporting documentation must be received by December 1. No extensions will be granted.

gre_general.value: The GRE is no longer required.
gre_general.quote: The GRE is no longer required.

app_fee.value: The Jacobs School application fee is 85 USD.
app_fee.quote: link to pay your $85 application fee

fee_waiver.value: Waivers are limited to named programs; none for international applicants.
fee_waiver.quote: We cannot grant fee waivers for any other reasons, including for international applicants.

supervisor.value: First-year students do lab rotations before choosing a lab.
supervisor.quote: PPBS students do two laboratory rotations in the fall and two to three more in the spring to decide on a lab they would like to join.

funding.value: Accepted students receive a full-tuition scholarship and a 35,000 USD stipend for five years.
funding.quote: All accepted students receive a full-tuition scholarship and stipend.

also.quote: you will receive a full-tuition scholarship and financial stipend ($35,000/year) for all the years of your study (5)

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field; ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

entry_route.value: Not stated on the pages checked

notes: Umbrella entry for ten Jacobs PhD tracks. The separate Jacobs Neuroscience PhD (fee $85) is not covered; neuro record is the Psychology PhD in Behavioral Neuroscience.
